description: Checks a monthly PPSI reserve disclosure against two statute-derived GENIUS Act S.394 §4 requirements: 1:1 reserve coverage arithmetic and attestation presence/timeliness against the statutory monthly cadence. Verdict per requirement (MET/NOT_MET/INDETERMINATE). NARROWED 2026-08-07, updated 2026-10-29: the permitted-asset composition check is out of scope in this row. The OCC issued its final implementing rule on 2026-10-21 (Bulletin 2026-50, 12 CFR Part 15, effective 2027-01-18); final rules of the other primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators were not checked. Never claims final-rule attribution or compliance certification. Cross-links the shipped pre-issuance precheck_reserve_attestation (art-06) and the fuller check_genius_reserve_disclosure (art-275).
deadline_note: GENIUS Act effective date is the earlier of 18 Jan 2027 or 120 days after final implementing regulations publish; the statutory 18 Jul 2026 rulemaking deadline was missed. The OCC issued its final implementing rule on 2026-10-21 (Bulletin 2026-50, 12 CFR Part 15, effective 2027-01-18); final rules of the other primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators were not checked. The 120-day leg from 2026-10-21 falls after the statutory 18-month date, so 2027-01-18 stands.

onchain_supply_check.note: User-pasted on-chain supply figure compared numerically against the reported outstanding-tokens field. Informational only, does not feed a requirement verdict. Never performs a network fetch, zero-fetch and zero-PII.

requirement_verdicts.detail: outstanding_tokens_reported is missing or non-positive — coverage ratio cannot be computed.
requirement_verdicts.ref: GENIUS Act, Pub. L. 119-27 (S.1582) §4(a) — 1:1 reserve coverage requirement

requirement_verdicts.detail: No monthly reserve report/attestation has been published for this period.
requirement_verdicts.ref: GENIUS Act, Pub. L. 119-27 (S.1582) §4(a)(3) — monthly reserve report, independent examination by a registered public accounting firm

output.scope_note: NARROWED 2026-08-07, updated 2026-10-29: checks 1:1 coverage arithmetic and attestation presence/timeliness only; the permitted-asset composition check is out of scope in this row. The OCC issued its final implementing rule on 2026-10-21 (Bulletin 2026-50, 12 CFR Part 15, effective 2027-01-18); final rules of the other primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators were not checked. Never treated as compliance certification.
